dog.description_text: This sweet, tricolored Hound mix puppy is just 3 months old and 14 lbs, with some big paws and adorable floppy ears to grow into! Autumn is busy learning all things puppy, stealing hearts with her sweetest eyes, and getting ready for a lifetime of adventures! She’s started her puppy vaccines and is looking for a loving forever family to grow up with. Autumn is a very calm girl. She loves to play and has high energy once play time starts and has bursts of puppy energy in middle of the day but outside of that she is very chill and just wants hugs and cuddles! Her personality is very calm and loving. She loves cuddles and kisses and remains chill once she has your presence and her favorite toy! She is truly the sweetest girl and learns sooo fast and is super attentive and observant for her age. She is friendly with kids, cats and her time of the day is anytime that involoves belly, playtime and learning new tricks!
dog.name: Autumn
